description: Land Title Settlement Department -Nawagamuwa, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510605
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property encumbrances. The content is focused on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
